title: Containers find each other by name

blocks.content: On a user-defined network, Docker runs a DNS resolver, so one container reaches another by its name. On the default bridge it cannot, which is why Compose creates a network for you.

docker network create app
docker run -d --net app --name db postgres:17
docker run -d --net app --name api myapi

# Inside api, the database is simply: db:5432

blocks.title: localhost means the container
blocks.content: Inside a container, localhost is that container, not your machine and not the database. Use the service name, or host.docker.internal to reach the host.
